info.title: OptimalAnt local plane reference
info.description: Single-process, loopback-only reference with SQLite persistence. This is not an API for optimalant.ai and has no authentication. Use synthetic data. Current source terms permit local inspection/evaluation only; no open-source or commercial-reuse license has been granted.

license.name: All rights reserved — local inspection and evaluation only

servers.description: Local reference. Do not expose publicly.

post.description: The server assigns startDate and createdAt. A repeated ID with identical request content returns the saved enrollment and current progress. Different content returns 409. The program version, prompt, and cases are pinned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Enrollment ID. This identifier is not authentication.

get.summary: Read enrollment and current computed progress

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Enrollment ID. This identifier is not authentication.

post.description: The server assigns date and recordedAt. A new snapshot replaces the entire day's prior values; omitted actions are not merged. Use a new event ID for a correction. Exact retries are deduplicated. New writes outside active round dates fail.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Enrollment ID. This identifier is not authentication.

post.summary: Create or retrieve a coaching trace
post.description: An existing ID returns its original trace, without another provider call. A new ID evaluates current stored progress. Live Claude calls require explicit server configuration. In-flight requests are deduplicated within one process; this is not an exactly-once provider guarantee after a crash.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Enrollment ID. This identifier is not authentication.

get.summary: Read coaching traces and reported outcomes

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Enrollment ID. This identifier is not authentication.

post.summary: Attach a participant-reported outcome to a trace
post.description: The trace must belong to this enrollment. Reports do not change progress, train a model, or prove causation. Same-ID identical retries return the saved outcome.

Parameters.description: Known program setting IDs only; values must meet the selected definition's range and integer requirements.

Values.description: Known action IDs only; each value must match the action's type and any integer requirement. This is a complete daily snapshot, not a patch.

Action.description: A numeric target is met at or above its value; booleans must equal their target. Weekly targets count distinct days meeting the action target, from 1 to 7.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone supported by the Node.js runtime.

visibleFields.description: Optional participant-field allowlist, enforced before local, custom, Claude, and fallback adapters. Omitted or empty means no participant data. Static program configuration and coach.md always remain visible; defaults are not personal overrides. Full replay inputs remain stored locally. This policy does not prevent invented claims in model output.

coach.description: Schema version 1 accepts this optional allowlist for backward compatibility. Unknown coach properties and unsupported schema versions are rejected. Existing enrollments keep their pinned policy.

ProgramDefinition.description: Versioned, trusted local program configuration. At least one required daily action; distinct action IDs; ascending milestone thresholds within duration; grace cannot exceed duration. These cross-field constraints are validated by the implementation.

Progress.description: Computed using the server's current time. Consistency includes grace gaps only after a later completed day bridges them. Weekly actions never gate daily completion.

CoachResult.description: A provider failure still returns a saved local response with fallback=true and sanitized failure metadata. It is not reported as successful AI.

input.description: Full local replay snapshot, retained in SQLite. The actual adapter input is a narrower projection selected by the pinned program coach.visibleFields; this object is not evidence that every stored field was sent to the coach.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone supported by the Node.js runtime.

visibleFields.description: Optional participant-field allowlist, enforced before local, custom, Claude, and fallback adapters. Omitted or empty means no participant data. Static program configuration and coach.md always remain visible; defaults are not personal overrides. Full replay inputs remain stored locally. This policy does not prevent invented claims in model output.

coach.description: Schema version 1 accepts this optional allowlist for backward compatibility. Unknown coach properties and unsupported schema versions are rejected. Existing enrollments keep their pinned policy.

Program.description: Versioned, trusted local program configuration. At least one required daily action; distinct action IDs; ascending milestone thresholds within duration; grace cannot exceed duration. These cross-field constraints are validated by the implementation.

CoachVisibleField.description: One exact supported participant-data path. [] selects a field on each row, not an arbitrary wildcard. Dynamic parameter/action IDs must be declared by this same program; cross-program IDs and unknown paths are rejected by runtime validation.

Error403.description: The Host or browser Origin is not accepted by this local server.

Error404.description: Route, enrollment, or linked trace not found.

Error405.description: Wrong method; see the Allow header.

Allow.description: The required method for this route.

Error409.description: Conflicting write ID, changed program content without a new version, inactive round, or local record bound.

Error422.description: Request fields or program-dependent values are invalid.

Error500.description: Unexpected internal failure; no request data or stack trace is returned.
